prompts.title: Set Up a Self-Improving Quality Gate for a Go Repository
prompts.description: Once per Go repository, when the code is already built and you want an automated gate that blocks sloppy, AI-generated Go code and gets stricter over time.
prompts.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 Medium

prompts.title: Optimize CI Speed Without Weakening Checks
prompts.description: Once per repository, when CI feedback is too slow — audit where pipeline time goes and restructure it toward sub-minute PR results without hiding or dropping any check.
prompts.author: Pontus Abrahamsson (@pontusab)

prompts.title: Untangle Codebase
prompts.description: Once per codebase, when it has grown tangled — a one-pass structural refactor so a typical change lands in one place and agents working in it break less.
prompts.author: Maze (@mazeincoding)

prompts.title: Prune Tests That Guard No Behavior
prompts.description: Once per codebase, when the test suite has grown bloated — delete or rewrite every test that guards no behavior so each remaining test fails on a regression and only on a regression.
prompts.author: Maze (@mazeincoding)

prompts.title: Optimize Web Font Loading Without Changing Rendering
prompts.description: Once per site, when web fonts are slowing page loads — subset, split and preload fonts to shrink font bytes as far as possible while keeping rendering pixel-identical.
prompts.author: Shu (@shuding)

prompts.title: Audit and Fix a Site's SEO and AI-Search (GEO) Readiness
prompts.description: Once per site, when you want every public page brought into compliance with Google's SEO guidance plus AI-search readiness — route inventory, per-page 9-point audit, prioritized fixes, and verified SEO/GEO scores.
prompts.author: Umut Bayraktar (@umutxyp)
